Your task is to use the proteomics meter to analyze the proteins of each of the 3 animal species, which can be found in the research building you're in, and determine which species is the anomoly. Once you have completed your task, drop the red flag directly beside (i.e. one square left/to the west) the statue of the animal species that is the anomoly.
